stops.stop: Langley Research Center, the desk machine against the IBM
stops.date_confidence: the flight date is attested. NASA's own 2015 account states plainly that Glenn requested she personally recheck the electronic computer's figures before the flight. The vivid 'get the girl' phrasing circulates only in post-2016 retellings, and one investigation is reported to have found no contemporaneous 1962 document fixing the exact wording. The Glenn line below is [R]: NASA prints it as Johnson's memory of him speaking, not as a record of his speech.

stops.stop: Washington, the Congressional Gold Medal
stops.date_confidence: [R] as to the ceremony. The authorization is solid: Public Law 116-68, 8 November 2019, granting Congressional Gold Medals to Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan, Mary Jackson, Christine Darden, and collectively to the women computers of NACA and NASA. The 18 September 2024 presentation date and the Capitol venue rest on the research pool's citation and could not be re-verified this session; the U.S. Mint page returned HTTP 403.
